title: Sprite-path terminal bodies never recede during crisis; the primitive fallback recedes the same surface — the shipping path diverges
detail: The shipping render path (sprite assets loaded by app and harness) applies no recede to terminal sprite bodies — only the wash/chip fade. Non-involved buildings stay fully saturated mid-crisis, contradicting the crisis-zone-only-saturation ruling; the unreachable primitive path recedes them.
recommended_fix: Recede the sprite path too (canvas-mix fill over dst, or a receded tint/bake), or remove the primitive-path body/roof recede and document the divergence as a pinned decision.

title: scan_col bounds-checks yi but indexes px with unguarded cx — out-of-bounds read on fixture/camera drift
detail: cx is used to index px without any bounds check while yi is checked; sibling procs scan_box/scan_dot guard both axes. Camera/geometry drift moving the sample column off-window reads out of bounds instead of failing a check.
recommended_fix: Mirror the sibling guards before indexing: `if cx < 0 || cx >= int(img.width) { continue }` (or clamp cx against img.width).

title: Dublin frontage recede scales alpha on DrawLineEx — inert under the rlsw line-alpha trap (goldens/harness), fades only on GPU
detail: The new recede path modulates line alpha, which the documented rlsw trap renders solid — so the frontage never visually recedes in software-rendered captures while the GPU build fades it. Vacuous recede leg, renderer divergence.
recommended_fix: Express the frontage recede as fill geometry (a thin quad, the spawn_fx band pattern) or comment the rlsw inertness as accepted.
